hold_reason.primary: No confirmed zero-cost API configuration is available that can support the required 240-request experiment.

evidence.finding: HTTP 402 Insufficient Balance on the smoke check; the account cannot be funded.

The free-tier quota visible in the principal investigator's AI Studio dashboard for Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is 20 requests per day. At that rate 240 requests require 12 days, so the pilot cannot be completed in a single day and resumability would first have to be designed and validated.
evidence.source: reported by the principal investigator from AI Studio; not independently verifiable from this repository

secondary_constraints: Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint is not documented as supporting request log-probabilities, and Gemini 3.x models cannot disable thinking, whose minimum budget (1,024 tokens) would consume a max_tokens budget of 220. A Gemini arm would therefore be a documented protocol deviation, not a like-for-like replication.
Groq documents that logprobs and top_logprobs return HTTP 400 and that n must be 1; its published rate table is labelled Developer-plan base limits, not free-tier limits.

A local model is not an automatic substitute: its knowledge of the July 2024 IPC-to-BNS transition has not been established, and the frozen Phase A run showed a 0-of-1,000 gold-section assertion rate on the L7 slice. Substituting it without validation would produce an incomparable claim.
what_this_is_not: not evidence that the detector, the judge or the uncertainty method failed
not a negative result about the legal-aware approach
not a completed pilot and not a satisfied Phase G research objective

multi_day_option.requirement: Resumability and quota behaviour must be designed and validated before a multi-day run is attempted. The current runner writes one item at a time but has no resume path, no mid-run approval checkpoint and no quota-exhaustion handling.

restart_conditions: A suitable zero-cost API tier or funding becomes available
The exact provider, model and model ID are verified as served on the account that will be used
Free-tier quotas (RPM, RPD, TPM, TPD) and billing status are confirmed, with no billing account linked if the zero-cost condition must hold
The experiment configuration is reviewed and a fresh approval hash is issued for that configuration
A two-request smoke check succeeds (non-empty content, no truncation at max_tokens, usage fields present) before any full run
For a multi-day run, resumability and quota behaviour are validated first
